sections.Profile:
The Robin Hood pinball machine, manufactured by Sega Enterprises, Ltd. in 1972, is an electro-mechanical, single-player game. It features a historical theme centered around the legend of Robin Hood.

- Manufacturer: Sega Enterprises, Ltd.
- Years made: 1972–1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Fairy tale, Historical Figure, Single Player, Original Theme, 1970s, Fantasy, Archery
